title: Hillock: neurotech skills for Claude Code
description:
32 Claude Code skills and 6 agents that give Claude the established workflows of neural engineering: leak-free BCI decoding evaluation, EEG/MEG preprocessing, spike sorting QC, noise diagnosis, real-time LSL pipelines and timing, TMS, tDCS, DBS and ultrasound stimulation, and neural device design, safety and FDA regulation. Includes 17 tested Python scripts and a 46-task benchmark of the mistakes these workflows prevent, graded by code.

Stimulation and device workflows are research and engineering support, not clinical decisions, regulatory sign-off or certification.
